description.value: Vij's is a landmark Indian restaurant on Vancouver's Cambie Street, a three-time recipient of the Michelin Bib Gourmand Award (2023–2025) recognized for exceptional cuisine and genuine hospitality. The menu spans vegetarian snacks, curries, seafood, and meat dishes alongside a curated beverage program with sommelier-guided wine pairings. Walk-in guests are always welcome, and seasonal patio seating makes it a viable stop for cyclists riding the Cambie corridor.
